title: A Stable 3d−4f Heterometallic Cluster with Magneto-Optical Activity

material_class.structural_family: Dy4 tetrahedron interpenetrating an Ni5 square pyramid

synthesis.procedure: Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.1 mmol, 45.6 mg), NiCl2·6H2O (0.1 mmol, 24 mg), NaHCO3 (0.3 mmol, 25 mg), and HL (8-hydroxyquinoline; 0.2 mmol, 28 mg) were dissolved in CH3OH/CH3CN (6 mL, v/v = 5:1) and stirred for 1 h at room temperature. The solution was sealed and heated in an oven at 80 °C for 72 h. After cooling to room temperature, green quadrilateral crystals were obtained. Yield: about 15 mg (33.3% based on Dy(NO3)3·6H2O). The main text only states that Dy4Ni5 was obtained from HL, NiCl2·6H2O, and Dy(NO3)3·6H2O in CH3OH/CH3CN (5:1) without numerical reagent amounts.
synthesis.temperature: stirred at room temperature, then heated at 80 °C, then cooled to room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed vessel heated in an oven (solvothermal)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooling to room temperature afforded green quadrilateral crystals

properties.summary: Solid Dy4Ni5 shows overall ferromagnetic coupling and magnetic anisotropy, with frequency-dependent out-of-phase AC signals indicating slow magnetic relaxation below 8 K. In DMSO solution the cluster shows a concentration-dependent Faraday magneto-optical effect at 532 nm; at saturation (18%) the specific rotation is 42.89 mdeg·mm−1 and the Verdet constant is 0.65 rad·m−1·T−1.

measurements.name: χmT
measurements.conditions: room temperature (300 K), 1 kOe; theoretical 61.68 cm^3 K mol^-1 for 4 Dy3+ (J = 15/2, g = 4/3, C = 14.17 cm^3 K mol^-1) and 5 Ni2+ (g = 2, S = 1). SI susceptibility method states 1 T.

measurements.name: χmT maximum
measurements.conditions: 2 K; χmT increases smoothly from 300 to 20 K then sharply to 2 K

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: 2 K, 10 kOe; isothermal M(H) at 2, 3, and 5 K from 0 to 90 kOe

measurements.name: magnetization maximum
measurements.conditions: high field up to 90 kOe; below the expected saturation of 50 Nβ

measurements.name: AC susceptibility / slow relaxation
measurements.conditions: zero DC field, 3 Oe AC, 311–2111 Hz; χm'' about 10% of χm' and frequency dependent below 8 K

measurements.name: specific Faraday rotation
measurements.conditions: DMSO solution, 532 nm, saturated concentration 18%; blank DMSO shows no response; linear concentration dependence with R^2 > 0.98

source_locations.location: CCDC QECTAX / 2133436; matches abstract cluster plus CH3CN
